annotations.title: Developer API Key, $10 Builder Pass & Institutional Checkout Provisioner

description: Returns pricing specifications, monthly query quotas, rate limits (RPM), 1-click Stripe Checkout links (starting at $10/mo MCP Builder Pass up to $9,500/yr FAR 13.2 GPC & Unlimited Closing Blanket licenses), Stripe Projects CLI commands (`stripe provision ariadnenexus`), and optional live Stripe Checkout session URLs (`mint_stripe_session: true`) for obtaining a live Ariadne Nexus Developer API key (`nexus_live_...`). Use when: an agent, developer, escrow attorney, or litigation desk needs pricing comparisons or a direct clickable Stripe Checkout URL after encountering a paymentChallenge on paid tools. Do not use when: redeeming an already-paid Stripe Checkout `cs_...` session ID for its API key (use redeem_checkout_session instead), or estimating basis-point RWA clearing take-rates (use calculate_clearing_fee instead). Behavior: Free discovery and checkout-link generator ($0.00 USD). Does not charge any payment method on invocation; billing only occurs if the human completes payment at the returned Stripe Checkout URL.

client_name.description: Optional organization, law firm, fund, or autonomous agent harness name to pre-populate in checkout metadata (default: "Autonomous Agent Desk").

email.description: Optional billing or technical contact email address to pre-populate in Stripe Checkout for automated API key fulfillment (default: "agent-ops@example.com").

mint_stripe_session.description: When true and paired with a valid buyer email, creates and returns a live checkout.stripe.com session URL alongside the 1-click redirect link (default: false).

symbol.description: Optional target ticker, 9-digit CUSIP, certificate ID, or SEC TCR docket reference for one-time institutional SKUs (default: "GS.30").

tier.description: Target subscription tier or one-time SKU: "EVAL_PASS" ($10/mo, 250 calls), "STARTER" ($99/mo, 10k calls), "QUANT_PRO" ($499/mo, 100k calls), "ENTERPRISE_CFO" ($2,499/mo, 1M calls), "SAFE_HARBOR_CERT_95" ($95 HUD-1 pass-through closing cert), "SINGLE_CUSIP_DOSSIER" ($195), "CERTIFIED_PLEADING_SAMPLE_295" ($295 100%-credited Rule 10b-5 sample), "ENTERPRISE_CLOSING_BLANKET_9500" ($9,500/yr unlimited closings), or "SOVEREIGN_POLICY_9500" ($9,500/yr FAR 13.2 GPC no-RFP license).

name: provision_agent_key

checkout_endpoint.description: HTTP endpoint to create a live Stripe Checkout session.

checkout_session_id.description: Created Stripe Checkout session ID (cs_...) when mint_stripe_session is true.

eval_pass_10_usd_url.description: 1-click checkout URL for the $10/mo MCP Builder & Evaluation Pass (250 calls/mo).

live_stripe_checkout_url.description: Direct checkout.stripe.com URL when mint_stripe_session is true.

message.description: Onboarding and instant checkout instructions summary.

one_click_checkout_url.description: Clickable 1-click URL that opens a live Stripe Checkout session in the browser.

persona_procurement_tracks.description: Tailored procurement tracks across developer, HUD-1 escrow pass-through, and FAR 13.2 / litigation personas.

post_checkout_next_step.description: Instructions to redeem the paid cs_... session ID via redeem_checkout_session.

selected_tier.description: Pricing, quota, and rate-limit metadata for the requested tier or SKU.
